notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list supports the Gum Island tower and its gone status; no build date, builder, design, staffing or fire history was found in 2 searches and about 6 page reads. Gaia GPS is a hiking-app location page, not a site authority. Refuge staff could confirm whether any footings or structure remain and whether the spot is open to visitors.
